name: Guadalupe River Trail
tagline: Twelve paved miles from the Bay into downtown, then a five-mile gap waiting on an unfinished flood project.

name: Los Alamitos & Guadalupe Creek Trails
tagline: Paved up Los Alamitos Creek to Harry Rd; Guadalupe Creek's trail stops at Singletree, waiting on bridges and a landfill.

name: Coyote Creek Trail
tagline: Bay to Anderson Dam. 21 miles connect; the north end is still in pieces.

name: San Francisco Bay Trail in San José
tagline: Under a mile open on the City's map, 17 on the regional one; the rest waits on Alviso's new shoreline levee.

cover.f: Alviso Marina County Park View At Sunset.jpg

name: Los Gatos Creek Trail
tagline: Lexington Dam to Willow Glen without a break, then it comes apart short of downtown.

name: Five Wounds Trail
tagline: A rail-trail through Little Portugal, waiting on BART, soil cleanup and a 1922 trestle.

cover.f: Five Wounds Portuguese National Church, Little Portugal, Santa Clara Street, San Jose 06.jpg

name: Thompson Creek Trail
tagline: Evergreen's creek trail: 1.7 paved miles from Lake Cunningham to Aborn Rd, six unfunded to the hills.

name: Three Creeks Trail
tagline: Willow Glen's rail-trail links Los Gatos Creek to the Guadalupe after a six-year trestle fight; Coyote Creek is still off the map.

cover.f: Three Creeks Trail decorative water tower.jpg

name: Silver Creek Trail
tagline: Valley Water rebuilt the creek and left levee roads; 19 years after the trail plan, under two miles are open.

cover.f: Lower Silver Creek, San Jose, California, US.jpg

name: Penitencia Creek Trail
tagline: From Berryessa BART to the edge of Alum Rock Park; both ends are a few hundred yards short.
